title: Kenyan Stilton Fried Rice
description: A flavorful twist on traditional fried rice, incorporating the bold flavors of Kenya and the richness of Stilton cheese.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add crumbled Stilton cheese and cook until lightly browned.
Add the Zesty Kenyan Rice and stir-fry until heated through.
If using, add fried onions and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, salt, and pepper to taste. Stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter.
Garnish with additional Stilton cheese and fried onions (if using).
